message: No detected input validation: The code reads config values and loads datasets without any schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards on the incoming data.
No detected untrusted source handling: No remote data fetching is visible in the code; data is loaded from local directories without any checksum verification or source authentication.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool such as Cleanlab.
No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious training samples is implemented anywhere in the visible data-preparation code path.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads model weights via torch.load(MODEL_PATH) without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision; it simply reads from a filesystem path with no integrity validation.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous sample detection before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural cleanse, activation analysis, gradient anomaly detection, or any other backdoor/trigger defense in the training loop.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) is imported or used anywhere in the training code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, etc.) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or used anywhere in the visible code.

No detected metric tampering protection: Although training and validation loaders are separated, there is no evidence of a held-out test set isolated from training decisions, hashing/signing of evaluation data, or multiple independent metrics to guard against manipulation.
No detected input sanitization: The code loads data through torchvision dataset classes and DataLoaders with no explicit input shape, range, or schema validation before passing data to the model.
No detected output bounds checks: There are no NaN guards, probability sanity checks, or threshold validation applied to model outputs anywhere in the visible inference/evaluation path.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a computer vision pipeline for radio galaxy classification, not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
